column6: I want water. I say: Please, give me water! You give me water. I drink the water. The water is good. Thank you!
I say yes. You say no. He says yes too. We say: yes, yes, yes! She says no. What is it — yes or no? It is yes!
Hello! I am here. You are there. I see you. You see me. We say hello. Hello! I give you water. You give me food. Good!
My friend is small. My friend is a child. My friend and I play. We read. We write. We learn. We say: good day, friend! Good day!
My mother is here. My father is there. Mother, father — I love you. We eat food. We drink water. The child sleeps. Good night, mother! Good night, father!
It is day. I go to school. I learn. I read. I write. I say: when is night? Night is time for sleep. I sleep. Good night!
